args.sql: WITH plan AS (SELECT seq,created_at,content_hash FROM harness_shared.plan_revisions WHERE workspace_id='papercusp-workspace' AND harness_slug='papercusp' AND plan_slug='rules-events-reuse-2026-10-28' ORDER BY seq DESC LIMIT 1), snap AS (SELECT computed_at,compute_ms,producer_version FROM harness_shared.derived_read_snapshots WHERE workspace_id='papercusp-workspace' AND harness_slug='' AND key='plans.lint') SELECT now() AS measured_at,p.seq AS plan_revision,p.created_at AS edit_epoch_ms,p.content_hash,s.computed_at AS snapshot_computed_epoch_ms,s.compute_ms,s.producer_version,s.computed_at < p.created_at AS predates_edit FROM plan p LEFT JOIN snap s ON true

SELECT now() AS measured_at,status,count(*)::int AS rows,count(*) FILTER(WHERE attempts=1 AND started_at IS NOT NULL AND outcome->>'coalescedInto' IS NULL)::int AS eligible_pairs,percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP(ORDER BY extract(epoch FROM(started_at-triggered_at))*1000) FILTER(WHERE attempts=1 AND started_at IS NOT NULL AND outcome->>'coalescedInto' IS NULL) AS enqueue_to_claim_p50_ms,percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP(ORDER BY extract(epoch FROM(started_at-triggered_at))*1000) FILTER(WHERE attempts=1 AND started_at IS NOT NULL AND outcome->>'coalescedInto' IS NULL) AS enqueue_to_claim_p95_ms FROM harness_shared.trigger_runs WHERE workspace_id='papercusp-workspace' AND triggered_at>=timestamptz '2026-10-28 00:00:00+00' AND triggered_at<timestamptz '2026-10-29 00:00:00+00' GROUP BY status ORDER BY status
args.positiveControlSql: SELECT id FROM harness_shared.trigger_runs WHERE workspace_id='papercusp-workspace' ORDER BY triggered_at DESC LIMIT 1

limitations: Lint measurement observes the workspace-scoped stored snapshot; it does not measure a live UI refresh or exact time to repair.
The preceding complete UTC24h trigger cohort is empty, verified against an existing same-table row; latency p50/p95 are unknown, never zero.
Trigger started_at is claim time and is overwritten on retry. Query excludes retry attempts and coalesced mirror rows; this is enqueue-to-claim, not proof of successful final dispatch.
These measurements alone cannot authorize a scheduling go or complete R4; attributable CPU/query/no-op and paired comparator evidence remain required.
